name: Rete.js
summary: A modular visual-programming node editor, not a general diagram editor. It was excluded after the packaging/feature gate: its postinstall script violates the no-install-scripts constraint and it does not provide X6-style stencils, snaplines or general shapes.

spike.notes: Excluded because the requirement forbids install scripts and this is not a general diagram editor. The postinstall script prints a message but still violates the policy as written.

blockers: Node/flow editor only, not a general diagram editor.
